Ice! Milk

Ice! Milk
A bucket of icy cold milk.
Drink to summon a snow zone around you
for 120 seconds — snow falls from the
sky, and any NPC inside turns icy blue
and slows down until they leave!

Drink to create a 120-second snow zone:
falling snow + NPCs inside turn icy blue
and move slower until they leave the zone
Time Milk

Time Milk
Crafted on the advanced-class stove with an
alarm clock and a normal bucket of milk.
Drink to instantly restore 50% stamina and
speed up by 10%! Then every 5 seconds you
regain half a point of stamina while the speed
boost holds, for 6 total ticks (30 seconds) —
and the final boost lingers 5 extra seconds.
Tick... tock...

Restores 50% stamina with +10% speed; every

Moo Milk
A bucket of milk from a very special cow.
Drink to restore 150% stamina WITHOUT
clearing events or buffs, and summon a
Polish cow right where you stand! (30%
chance it comes out angry)

Restores 150% stamina without clearing
events/buffs, and summons a Polish cow

Silent Milk
A specially blended quiet milk.
Drink to go silent for 60 seconds —
nothing you do makes a sound unless
you're seen. Afterwards you're slowed
for 15 seconds!

Compressed Milk
A chunk of iron-fortified condensed
milk.
Restores 400 stamina, but squishes you
and slows you down for 20 seconds —
and normal milk CAN'T undo it. You'll
also stick to doors (hold Run to break
free).

Milk is Good

Milk makes you stronger... and richer.
Every bottle of milk you drink this run
adds +5 YTP to your final end-of-floor
payout. (Quiz answers and feeding Baldi
apple milk both count.)

Milk Update!

Hello Baldi's Basics Plus mod community players!

Thank you for playing this milk branch update! This update is focused on some QOL improvements—and a few other things... Milk!
The biggest change is that milk has been reworked functionally and visually. The most important part? Milk now has a brand new effect—be sure to test it yourself.
